items: Lawmakers ask USPS to restore island air transport. Reps. Jill Tokuda and James Moylan led a bipartisan, bicameral letter asking Postmaster General David Steiner to reverse Ground Advantage changes for noncontiguous states and territories. They say USPS has moved packages under one pound mainly by boat since Oct. 1, 2026, which could stretch delivery to 10 days or more, and they asked for a reply by Nov. 25.

GOFO signs full-building Charlotte lease. Constellation Real Estate Partners said GOFO leased all 374,220 square feet of Constellation 485 South at 1850 Continental Boulevard, on 25.91 acres. The source gives no start date; GOFO is a last-mile carrier founded in Los Angeles in August 2023.

USPS proposes postage-advance rule for resetting companies. USPS proposed amending its Postage Evidencing Systems regulations to address days when a resetting company's advances exceed the daily average funds advanced amount it keeps on deposit. Comments are due by Dec. 14, 2026, per the Federal Register notice.
